skill.name: Configure SwarmZero Agent Observability
skill.description: Set environment variable AGENTOPS_API_KEY and initialize AgentOps to enable full observability tracking and analysis of SwarmZero agents, including behavior, performance metrics, and interactions.
skill.skill_body:
To enable observability for SwarmZero agents: (1) Set AGENTOPS_API_KEY in your environment. (2) Initialize AgentOps in your SwarmZero application. This enables tracking of agent behavior, performance, and interactions on the AgentOps dashboard.

## Objective

Enable full observability for SwarmZero agents
## Applicable Signals

- SwarmZero framework selected as target
- Observability requirement identified
- Pre-deployment setup phase

## Contraindications

- AGENTOPS_API_KEY is unavailable or not provisioned
- SwarmZero is not the target agentic framework
- Observability infrastructure not accessible

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Set AGENTOPS_API_KEY environment variable', 'detail': 'Export or configure AGENTOPS_API_KEY in your deployment environment'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Initialize AgentOps', 'detail': 'Call AgentOps initialization in your SwarmZero application code'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Verify observability connection', 'detail': 'Confirm SwarmZero agents emit data to AgentOps dashboard'}

## Constraints

- AGENTOPS_API_KEY must be set before initialization
- AgentOps initialization must occur before SwarmZero agent execution

## Output Contract

- SwarmZero agents emit observability data to AgentOps dashboard; agent behavior, performance metrics, and interactions are tracked and visible in the monitoring interface.
